title: What If Every Coal Power Plant Shut Down Tomorrow?
subject: coal power plant

scenes.text: What if every coal plant switched off tomorrow? A third of the world's power would vanish.
Coal still made about 35 percent of all electricity in 2024, around 10,700 terawatt-hours.
The next day, grids would need other sources to cover that gap, and wind and solar are not there yet.
Solar and wind together made about 14 percent of world power in 2024, far short of coal's share.
Blackouts would hit first where coal runs most of the grid, like India, where coal use rose again in 2024.
Coal is the dirtiest power we have, yet it is also the one keeping the lights on.
